newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Far East Cons may list hotels abroad.
newsitem.headline: Far East Cons may list hotels abroad.

text.p: Property and hotels group Far East Consortium International Ltd said Thursday it was considering a spinning off some of its property and hotel operations for listing abroad.
"We are considering a spinoff of assets in overseas markets, including Malaysia, the Philippines, New York or even Canada," managing director Kohei Ogawa said in an interview.
Ogawa said the assets would comprise mainly overseas properties excluding those in China.
The company has property developments in the United States, Malaysia, Singapore, China, Australia and Thailand.
"We have conducted discussions with some merchant banks (regarding the spinoff) but no application has been made so far to any of those stock exchanges," Ogawa said.
Ogawa declined to comment on timing.
The company currently owns and manages a five-star hotel in Melbourne and a four-star hotel in Dallas. Hotels in Colombo and Singapore are under construction.
The company shares fell one cent to HK$1.18 in mid-morning.
